description: This file defines the 'Flat' shipping model class for OpenCart, handling the calculation of a flat-rate shipping quote based on configuration and geographic zone.

classes.name: Flat
classes.description: A class representing a flat rate shipping method, capable of generating shipping quotes based on geographic zone and configuration parameters.

methods.name: getQuote
methods.description: Calculates and returns a shipping quote based on the provided address, including checking geographic zone and applying configured costs and taxes.
